one-piece-open: One undivided 245.4 mL bin. A flat round face covers the bore and a closed finger cup provides the grip.
one-piece-left-right: The fixed divider runs the length of the bin, creating two long lanes.
one-piece-front-back: One chevron divider separates front from back. Its pitched shape prints without supports.
dry-ends: Four feet cradle the two outside ends of the bottom row. Each rear rail clicks into its front foot.
base-mount: A shared foot supports adjacent bottom cores. The rear rail clicks into the front socket.
upper-mount: Three rim seats join staggered cores. Press the front junction onto the rail from the rear junction.
middle-mount: Fasten the rear junction to plywood with a #8 wood screw. Seat the front junction over its printed rail.
top-tier: A linked upper junction and a linked top clip capture the top cell. Screw the rear tab into plywood.
top-clips: A rail on the rear screw tab captures the front keeper over the top rim.
core: Reused spool tube, not printed. This example uses nominal 83 mm ID × 88 mm OD × 60 mm length.
wood-screw: A #8 × ¾″ pan-head wood screw through the rear tab fastens it to the plywood. The shelf supports the bank.
triangle-pocket: A small removable tray for screws or pins. Its frames stay linked above the tray.
triangle-pocket-frame: The front socket clips onto a rail printed with the rear frame. Both frames stay in place when the drawer slides out.
left-pocket: Wide pull-out pocket on the left of row two. The upright sits beside its inner wall.
left-pocket-frame: The front socket clips onto a rail printed with the rear frame. Both frames stay in place when the drawer slides out.
right-pocket: Wide pull-out pocket on the right of row two. The upright sits beside its inner wall.
right-pocket-frame: The front socket clips onto a rail printed with the rear frame. Both frames stay in place when the drawer slides out.
